items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And he had a banjo player by the name of Walter

ctx.x: He sang on Creole numbers. A few, a few numbers he sang, you know. Yeah. But he had Walter, that's what Walter mostly did. He was singing because Walter was no, no exploit player, you know.

Mm-hmm. Well what did René Parker sing? He said Creole, what did I sing Creole? Yeah, he sang. He sang Elabar and things like that, yeah. And what about the people down there in Blackmon? And what number did they like?
